data.name: Vijaykumar
data.gender_notes: Vijaykumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Vijaykumar is derived from the Sanskrit words 'vijaya' meaning victory and 'kumar' meaning young boy or prince. It is a powerful name that signifies courage, strength, and victory. The name Vijaykumar carries the meaning “Victorious Warrior” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vijaykumar usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vijaykumar is a name that resonates with the divine energy of the Hindu god, Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe. It signifies the power of the divine within, and the ability to overcome all obstacles with courage and strength.
data.etymology: Vijaykumar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious Warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vijaykumar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
